title: moeb init does not create signals/catalogue subdirectory or stub index.md
description: Running `moeb init` creates `.moeb/signals/` but does not create the required `.moeb/signals/catalogue/` subdirectory or the stub `signals/index.md` file. Any subsequent `moeb fix-signal` or signal-writing operation assumes both exist and will fail or produce unexpected state. A freshly initialised project cannot be used with the canonical fix-signal skill without manual directory creation.
proposed_resolution:
In `src/moeb/src/commands/init.rs`, after `fs::create_dir_all(&signals_dst)`: (1) add `fs::create_dir_all(signals_dst.join("catalogue"))?`; (2) write a stub `index.md` to `signals_dst` containing the canonical header:
# Signal Index

| Signal ID | Title | Category | Severity | Status | Occurrences | Last Seen | File |
|-----------|-------|----------|----------|--------|-------------|-----------|------|
